responsibility: Declares the bridge between gm2 symbol-table identifiers and GCC `Tree` nodes. Its API lets later semantic and code-generation stages record the GCC object associated with a Modula-2 symbol, query whether such a mapping exists, install and retract temporary placeholder entries, remove mappings when symbols leave scope, and explicitly poison entries so stale backend trees are not reused after scope exit or other lifetime changes.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file publishes the symbol-to-GCC-tree conversion API—lookup, insertion, temporary-known markers, removal, and poisoning—while hiding the indexed storage and constant-resolution behavior that are implemented in `SymbolConversion.mod`.
